svg.title: Filter Coffee Club — loading ring with steady coffee brew animation
svg.desc: The orange inner ring runs as an indeterminate loader while a steady cadence of coffee drips into the carafe.
svg.metadata: Structural reconstruction of 12-sparse-beige-stipple-grounds-transparent.png. Geometric elements are native SVG primitives. The hand-lettered outlines and two connected brewer-detail shapes are retained from cleaned source contours. Warm print grain is procedural and does not contain embedded raster data.
